Name: Kenneth's Birthday and Gift Guide
Author: Kf29
Description:
[size=4][b]Ever forget whose birthday is today and end up giving them trash?[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]I got you bro.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Kenneth's Birthday & Gift Guide is your daily calendar buddy. Every morning you get a mail telling you if someone has a birthday today, who has a birthday tomorrow, and what they actually love. Plus quick tips for free gifts you can grab that season.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]No more checking the wiki. No more giving Haley a daffodil and losing friendship.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]What makes it different?[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- While Inspirational is about cozy quotes and Motivational is about hustle, this one is pure utility - it helps you make friends faster.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]What you get:[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- 112 Unique Mails - No repeats, from Spring to Winter.[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Today & Tomorrow Alerts - "TODAY is Kent's birthday!" and "Heads up - Lewis is tomorrow!"[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Loved Gifts Listed - Kent LOVES Roasted Hazelnut, Lewis LOVES Hot Pepper, etc.[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Free Gift Tips - Daffodils in Spring, Salmonberries, Blackberries, Quartz from mines.[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Lightweight - Content Patcher only, zero lag, works with everything.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Example: "Good morning! It's Spring 4 - TODAY is Kent's birthday! Kent LOVES Roasted Hazelnut. Bring it for big friendship!"[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Perfect if you want to max hearts fast without trying too hard. Great for new players and completionists.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Made by Kf - for farmers who want to be everyone's best friend.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Install: SMAPI + Content Patcher. Drop in Mods.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Compatibility - Can I install all your mail mods together?[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Yes! You can install all of them at the same time, no problem.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]- All my mail mods are separate, so they work together.[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Want only one vibe? Install just one.[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Want a full mailbox every morning? Install them all - you'll get Birthday + Helper + Inspirational + Lore etc. in one day.[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- No conflicts, no overwrites, lightweight Content Patcher only.[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Works with Vanilla and Expanded, any farm, any save.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]All mail mods by Kf:[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Kenneth's Birthday & Gift Guide[/b][/size]
